title: Data-Driven Discovery of Polar Organic Cocrystals: Integration of Machine Learning and Automated Screening.
summary: AutoGluon models prioritize candidate coformers from molecular descriptors, followed by automated synthesis and structural screening. The source reports 13 confirmed pairs, six in polar space groups; diffraction/characterization supports the specific experimental result.
